$comment: Earth science course outline. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track (S1); the zero-to-hero core is added at M1. Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: earth
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied required Earth science in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.

Teaching order follows research/verified-2026-11-15.json earth-inquiry final_units (the 領綱 order is not a teaching order), grouped into themed parts; every official dependsOn edge between covered codes is respected.
Practice items are original and only modelled on the 112–115 papers; official papers are linked, never copied.

Owner approved the 自然 sprint outline (2026-11-16): keep the 60-chapter size; write ONE subject at a time (rate limits); biology relies on the shared inquiry exam-skills part; the shared 自然 mock is the only science practice paper; environment-energy stays one chapter.
Owner (2026-11-16): earth/s116-universe-stars keeps its physics/s116-em-waves prerequisite; the chapter briefly recaps the EM spectrum in place AND links to that physics chapter as the source.
openQuestions: Official dependsOn edges EEd-Vc-3/4 → physics PKc-Vc-6 and EHb-Vc-1/2 → chemistry CAa-Vc-4 are met with cross-subject prereqs (physics/s116-em-waves, chemistry/s116-atomic-structure), so the first Earth chapter now sits behind much of the physics sprint. Research suggests teaching the EM spectrum and isotopes inline instead; the owner could sign waivers for these edges and drop the prereqs.

Research ties universe scale to scientific notation (國中 INc-Ⅳ-1~4), reviewed in math/s116-logarithms; not added as a prereq (physics/s116-em-waves already brings it into the ancestry if the physics sprint reaches it). Confirm.
Research: exponential decay / half-life has no verified science curriculum code; the math/s116-growth-models prereq rests on math F-11A-4 (衰退模型).
Exam-item links (examItems) and reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2.

Integrator (2026-11-16): the 45-min s116-earth-practice-set capstone was removed; the shared original 自然 mock paper is inquiry/s116-sci-mock, so no subject keeps its own practice paper (physics, chemistry and biology have none). Owner to confirm.

question.zh-tw: 夜空中的星星有多遠、多亮，又為什麼會移動？
question.en: How far and how bright are the stars, and why do they move across the sky?

parts.whyHere: Research final_units orders 1–3 (EEd) open the course; physics/s116-em-waves is a prereq because EEd-Vc-3/4 officially depend on PKc-Vc-6 (research: EM spectrum from radio to gamma). EFb-Vc-1 (unit 7) and EId-Vc-1 (unit 22) are grouped here because EId-Vc-1 depends only on EFb-Vc-1 and both are apparent-motion topics on the celestial sphere.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修地球科學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required Earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 宇宙的組成與恆星的觀測

blurb.zh-tw: 宇宙的尺度與膨脹、星等與光度，以及從多波段觀測與顏色認識恆星。
blurb.en: The scale and expansion of the universe, magnitude and luminosity, and what multi-wavelength light and colour say about stars.

objectives.zh-tw: 依尺度排列恆星、星團、星系、星系群與宇宙，並說明宇宙膨脹的證據
objectives.en: Order stars, clusters, galaxies, galaxy groups and the universe by scale, and state the evidence for expansion

objectives.zh-tw: 區分視星等、絕對星等、亮度與光度
objectives.en: Tell apparent and absolute magnitude, brightness and luminosity apart

objectives.zh-tw: 由恆星顏色判斷表面溫度，並說明為何需要多波段觀測
objectives.en: Infer surface temperature from a star's colour and explain why astronomy needs more than visible light

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: scale and hierarchy only; magnitude explained from principles; EM bands kept brief (EM spectrum reviewed in physics/s116-em-waves, PKc-Vc-6); colour–temperature at principle level.

title.zh-tw: 恆星的視運動與太陽的季節位置
title.en: Apparent motion of the stars and the Sun through the seasons

blurb.zh-tw: 恆星的周日運動與周年運動，以及太陽每日位置隨季節的變化。
blurb.en: Diurnal and annual motion of the stars, and how the Sun's daily path changes with the seasons.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明不同緯度所見恆星周日運動的差異
objectives.en: Explain how stars' diurnal motion looks at different latitudes

objectives.zh-tw: 描述春分、夏至、秋分、冬至時太陽在當地的位置
objectives.en: Describe the Sun's local position at the equinoxes and solstices

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: the 天球 may be used but no celestial coordinates; annual motion qualitative only.

question.zh-tw: 地球怎麼形成，內部長什麼樣子，臺灣又為什麼多地震？
question.en: How did Earth form, what is inside it, and why does Taiwan have so many earthquakes?

parts.whyHere: Research final_units 8–10 (EHa, EHb), then 4 (EFa-Vc-1/2), 11–13 (EIa) and 24 (EMd-Vc-4). EHa-Vc-1 depends on EEd-Vc-1; EIa-Vc-1 depends on EFa-Vc-1/2; EIa-Vc-4 on EIa-Vc-2/3; EMd-Vc-4 on EIa-Vc-4 and EFa-Vc-1. Research correction: radiometric dating needs isotopes (chemistry CAa-Vc-4), hence the chemistry/s116-atomic-structure prereq. The half-life step uses exponential decay, reviewed in math/s116-growth-models (F-11A-4 衰退模型).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修地球科學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required Earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 太陽系、宜居的地球與地質年代
title.en: The solar system, habitable Earth and geologic time

blurb.zh-tw: 太陽星雲說、地球的宜居條件與大氣演化，以及相對與絕對地質年代。
blurb.en: The solar nebula hypothesis, why Earth is habitable and how its atmosphere evolved, and relative and absolute geologic age.

objectives.zh-tw: 以太陽星雲說說明太陽系的形成與成員
objectives.en: Use the solar nebula hypothesis to explain how the solar system formed and what it contains

objectives.zh-tw: 比較地球與其他類地行星的宜居條件，並說明大氣組成的演變
objectives.en: Compare Earth's habitability with other terrestrial planets and describe how its atmosphere changed

objectives.zh-tw: 用化石與地層關係排序地層，並以半衰期估算絕對年代
objectives.en: Order strata with fossils and rock relationships, and estimate absolute age from half-life

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: nebula evolution and its evidence are elective (EHa-Va-1); isotopes reviewed in chemistry/s116-atomic-structure (CAa-Vc-4); verify any half-life value against a primary source before use.

title.zh-tw: 地球的分層與板塊構造學說
title.en: Earth's layers and the theory of plate tectonics

blurb.zh-tw: 由地震波認識地球分層，以及從大陸漂移、海底擴張到板塊構造的科學史。
blurb.en: Earth's layers from seismic waves, and the history of science from continental drift and seafloor spreading to plate tectonics.

objectives.zh-tw: 由地震波速度隨深度的變化判讀地殼、地函、地核、岩石圈與軟流圈
objectives.en: Read crust, mantle, core, lithosphere and asthenosphere from a wave-speed vs depth graph

objectives.zh-tw: 說明 S 波無法通過外核的意義
objectives.en: Explain what it means that S waves cannot cross the outer core

objectives.zh-tw: 說明板塊構造學說如何隨證據累積而建立
objectives.en: Explain how plate tectonics was built up as evidence accumulated

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: no formula derivation for wave speeds; physical layering is the emphasis, chemical layering only mentioned.

title.zh-tw: 板塊邊界、臺灣的板塊環境與地震
title.en: Plate boundaries, Taiwan's tectonic setting and earthquakes

blurb.zh-tw: 聚合、張裂、錯動邊界的地質作用，臺灣位於聚合型邊界的證據，以及地震規模、震度與預警。
blurb.en: Processes at convergent, divergent and transform boundaries, the evidence that Taiwan sits on a convergent boundary, and earthquake magnitude, intensity and early warning.

objectives.zh-tw: 比較三種板塊邊界的岩漿、變質、構造與震源分布
objectives.en: Compare magmatism, metamorphism, structures and focal distribution at the three boundary types

objectives.zh-tw: 由地質構造與震源分布推論臺灣的板塊邊界
objectives.en: Infer Taiwan's plate boundary from structures and focal distribution

objectives.zh-tw: 區分地震規模與震度，並說明地震預警的原理
objectives.en: Distinguish magnitude from intensity and explain how earthquake early warning works

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: volcanic eruption styles not covered; avoid unsettled details of Taiwan tectonic models; check 規模/震度 definitions against CWA (中央氣象署) before writing.

question.zh-tw: 雲是怎麼形成的，風又為什麼會吹？
question.en: How do clouds form, and what makes the wind blow?

parts.whyHere: Research final_units 5 (EFa-Vc-3), 14–15 (EIb-Vc-1~4) and 16–17 (EIb-Vc-5/6). EIb-Vc-1~3 and EIb-Vc-5 depend on EFa-Vc-3; EIb-Vc-4 on EIb-Vc-1~3; EIb-Vc-6 on EIb-Vc-5. Prereq on s116-earth-layers-plates because EFa-Vc-3 continues the same 次主題 (Fa, Earth's layered structure).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修地球科學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required Earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 大氣的垂直結構、水氣與成雲
title.en: Vertical structure of the atmosphere, water vapour and clouds

blurb.zh-tw: 大氣溫度與壓力的垂直變化、飽和與濕度，以及空氣上升冷卻成雲。
blurb.en: How temperature and pressure change with height, saturation and humidity, and how rising air cools to form cloud.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明大氣溫度與壓力垂直變化的基本原因
objectives.en: Explain the basic causes of the vertical temperature and pressure profiles

objectives.zh-tw: 由飽和水氣壓曲線判讀露點、相對濕度與絕對濕度
objectives.en: Read dew point, relative and absolute humidity from the saturation vapour pressure curve

objectives.zh-tw: 說明空氣上升膨脹冷卻而成雲或霧
objectives.en: Explain how rising air expands, cools and forms cloud or fog

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: supersaturation not covered; rising air treated as adiabatic; no atmospheric stability or dry/moist lapse rates.

title.en: What drives the wind, and weather maps

blurb.zh-tw: 氣壓梯度力、科氏力、摩擦力與風，以及地面天氣圖的判讀。
blurb.en: Pressure-gradient force, Coriolis force, friction and wind, and reading surface weather maps.

objectives.zh-tw: 畫出地轉風與近地面風的受力圖
objectives.en: Draw force diagrams for geostrophic and near-surface wind

objectives.zh-tw: 說明地面高低壓的輻合、輻散與天氣
objectives.en: Explain convergence and divergence at surface highs and lows and the weather they bring

objectives.zh-tw: 由等壓線判讀高低壓與主要天氣系統
objectives.en: Identify highs, lows and major weather systems from isobars

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: forces qualitative only, no formulas; satellite cloud images only as a supplement.

question.zh-tw: 海水怎麼流動，又如何影響天氣與海岸？
question.en: How does seawater move, and how does it shape weather and coasts?

parts.whyHere: Research final_units 6 (EFa-Vc-4/5), 18 (EIc-Vc-1), 19 (EIb-Vc-7), 20–21 (EIc-Vc-2~4). Research correction applied: surface currents and prevailing winds (EIc-Vc-1) before El Niño (EIb-Vc-7), which depends on EIc-Vc-1, EIb-Vc-5 and EFa-Vc-5.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修地球科學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required Earth science in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 海水性質、表面海流與聖嬰現象
title.en: Seawater properties, surface currents and El Niño

blurb.zh-tw: 表層鹽度與海水溫度分布、表面海流與盛行風，以及海氣交互作用與聖嬰現象。
blurb.en: Surface salinity and ocean temperature, surface currents and prevailing winds, and ocean–atmosphere interaction with El Niño.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明降水、蒸發與河水注入如何影響表層鹽度
objectives.en: Explain how precipitation, evaporation and river input set surface salinity

objectives.zh-tw: 連結表面海流與盛行風
objectives.en: Link surface ocean currents to the prevailing winds

objectives.zh-tw: 用赤道太平洋東西兩側的觀測資料說明聖嬰現象
objectives.en: Explain El Niño from observed data on the eastern and western equatorial Pacific

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: no vertical salinity profile; deep thermohaline circulation is elective (EIc-Va-1); no detailed Southern Oscillation or other El Niño indices.

blurb.zh-tw: 波浪的成因與對海岸的影響，以及潮汐週期與臺灣海峽的潮流。
blurb.en: Where waves come from and how they shape coasts, and tidal cycles and tidal currents in the Taiwan Strait.

objectives.zh-tw: 區分風浪與湧浪，並說明瘋狗浪與颱風前湧浪的危險
objectives.en: Tell wind waves from swell and explain the dangers of rogue waves and pre-typhoon swell

objectives.zh-tw: 由觀測資料說明日、地、月對潮汐的影響
objectives.en: Use observed data to show how the Sun, Earth and Moon drive the tides

objectives.zh-tw: 判讀潮位資料並比較臺灣海峽各地的潮流
objectives.en: Read tide data and compare tidal currents along the Taiwan Strait

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review chapter: key ideas, original 學測-style worked examples, documented traps, links to official CEEC items, self-check quiz. Depth limits: the Moon is the main tidal cause; use official CWA tide data (中央氣象署; the 領綱 says 中央氣象局, its former name).
